points.title: Write accepted
points.condition: i_wr_en=1 and o_full=0 at a write clock edge.

points.title: Rejected unblocked write (full)
points.condition: i_wr_en=1, o_full=1, i_rst_n_sw=1 and o_sw_rst_busy=0.

points.title: o_overflow pulse observed
points.condition: o_overflow=1 sampled at a write clock edge.

points.title: Three or more consecutive rejected writes
points.condition: A rejected unblocked write that is at least the third in a row of consecutive rejected writes.

points.title: Write request during software reset block
points.condition: i_wr_en=1 while i_rst_n_sw=0 or o_sw_rst_busy=1.

points.title: Software reset sequence starts
points.condition: o_sw_rst_busy=0 and i_rst_n_sw=0 at a write edge.

points.title: Software reset low level of exactly 1 cycle
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw returns to 1 after a low level that lasted exactly one write cycle.

points.title: Software reset low level of 3 to 9 cycles
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw returns to 1 after a low level of 3 to 9 write cycles.

points.title: Software reset low level of 10 or more cycles
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw returns to 1 after a low level of at least 10 write cycles.

points.title: o_sw_rst_busy falls (sequence completion)
points.condition: o_sw_rst_busy was 1 at the previous write edge and is 0 now.

points.title: Busy held for 3 or more cycles
points.condition: o_sw_rst_busy=1 for at least the fourth consecutive write cycle.

points.title: New software reset request while busy
points.condition: i_rst_n_sw=0 while o_sw_rst_busy=1.

points.title: Software reset started while FIFO full
points.condition: Software reset start (busy 0, i_rst_n_sw 0) when o_full was 1 unblocked in the previous cycle.

points.title: o_full rises
points.condition: o_full=1 without block while it was not full in the previous write cycle.

points.title: o_full falls
points.condition: o_full=0 now while the previous write cycle had unblocked o_full=1.

points.title: Simultaneous accepted write and read
points.condition: i_wr_en with o_full=0 and i_rd_en with o_empty=0 sampled at a write edge.

points.title: Write to full FIFO with read request accepted (no bypass)
points.condition: i_wr_en=1, o_full=1 unblocked, with i_rd_en=1 and o_empty=0.

points.title: o_full_thr active while not full
points.condition: o_full_thr=1 and o_full=0.

points.title: Blocked write: o_full_thr shows empty value 1 (threshold 0)
points.condition: Blocked, i_full_thr=0 and o_full_thr=1.

points.title: Blocked write: o_full_thr 0 (threshold not 0)
points.condition: Blocked, i_full_thr!=0 and o_full_thr=0.

points.title: Full threshold above DEPTH while FIFO full
points.condition: i_full_thr > DEPTH, o_full=1 unblocked, o_full_thr=0.

points.title: Full threshold equal DEPTH at full
points.condition: i_full_thr == DEPTH, o_full=1 unblocked and o_full_thr=1.

points.title: Write pointer wrap
points.condition: Accepted write that is the 2xDEPTH-th since the helper count was cleared.

points.title: Second write pointer wrap
points.condition: Write pointer wrap after a previous wrap already occurred.

points.title: Write-domain hardware reset during activity, release observed
points.condition: First write edge after release of a reset that hit while traffic, full or software reset was active.

points.title: Write-domain hardware reset while overflow pulse active
points.condition: First write edge after release of a reset that was asserted when an overflow pulse was active.

points.title: Hardware reset during software reset sequence
points.condition: First write edge after release of a reset that was asserted during a software reset sequence.

points.title: Read accepted
points.condition: i_rd_en=1 and o_empty=0 at a read clock edge.

points.title: Rejected unblocked read (empty)
points.condition: i_rd_en=1, o_empty=1 and o_sw_rst_busy=0.

points.title: o_underflow pulse observed
points.condition: o_underflow=1 sampled at a read clock edge.

points.title: Three or more consecutive rejected reads
points.condition: A rejected unblocked read that is at least the third in a row.

points.title: Read request during software reset block
points.condition: i_rd_en=1 while o_sw_rst_busy=1 (o_empty=1).

points.title: o_empty rises
points.condition: o_empty=1 unblocked while it was 0 in the previous read cycle.

points.title: o_empty falls
points.condition: o_empty=0 now while it was 1 in the previous read cycle.

points.title: Four or more back-to-back accepted reads
points.condition: Accepted read that is at least the fifth consecutive accepted read.

points.title: o_empty_thr active while not empty
points.condition: o_empty_thr=1 and o_empty=0, not busy.

points.title: o_empty_thr inactive (occupancy above threshold)
points.condition: o_empty_thr=0 and o_empty=0.

points.title: Empty threshold above DEPTH with data present
points.condition: i_empty_thr > DEPTH, o_empty=0, not busy, o_empty_thr=1.

points.title: Read pointer wrap
points.condition: Accepted read that is the 2xDEPTH-th since the helper count was cleared.

points.title: Read-domain hardware reset during activity, release observed
points.condition: First read edge after release of a reset asserted while the FIFO was non-empty or busy.
